UPON hearing the counsel, the Court made the following  O R D E R
Our attention is drawn to the order dated 14.10.2024 passed in SLP(Crl.) No. 11376/2024, titled Amar Sadhuram Mulchandani vs. Directorate of Enforcement & Anr..

entities.text: Amar Sadhuram Mulchandani vs. Directorate of Enforcement & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Issue notice, returnable in the week commencing 27.01.2025.

Notice will be served by all modes,
including dasti.
Learned counsel for the informant is present and submits that the petitioner, Amar Sadhuram Mulchandani, has been undertaking normal activities.
The informant is not made a party to the present special leave petition.
Nevertheless, we permit the informant to submit and place evidence in the above regard and other relevant documents on record.

Till the next date of hearing, subject to the petitioner, Amar Sadhuram Mulchandani, joining and cooperating with the investigation, he shall not be arrested in connection with First Information Report No. 806/2019 dated 19.07.2019 registered with Police Station  Pimpri, District  Pimpri-Chinchwad, Maharashtra, for the offence(s) punishable under Sections 420, 406, 409, 465,
467, 468 and 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
 (DEEPAK GUGLANI) (R.S. NARAYANAN)
